full_judgment: 39. We already noticed above that prosecution examined 16 PWs out of 21 CS witnesses. PWs 11-14 were tendered, PW 9,10, 15 and 16 were official and formal witnesses such as PM doctor, .constable escorting dead body of the deceased and 2 investigation officers. PW 9 proved PM report (Exhibit 2) PW 15 proved that he prepared Map and Index (Exhibit 3, 3A) of the place of occurrence and seizure list (Exhibit 4) by which he seized Mat Exhibit I-I(E) such as blood stained earth, panjabi, sandal, genji, lungi and chadar. PW 16 proved that he received written first information report (Exhibit 1) and filled up form to start PS Case. PW 16 submitted charge-sheet in the case. PWs 1-8 were public witnesses, out of them PWs 2-6 were eye witnesses to the main occurrence as to causing dagger blow injury on the chest of Julfu Master by accused Abul Khair. PW 8 Chairman Salamat Kha stated that he was present with Julfu Master and PWs 2-6 in the first salish held at 8-00 PM on 1-7-1988 in Master Bazar over quarrel between karmachari of accused Abul Khair and Abul Kalam PW 8 stated that Julfu Master and PWs 2-6 attended the second salish held in his house. PW 6 Abdul Barek, Bhatija of Julfu Master, stated that he came after occurrence and started with injured Julfu Master by boat towards Chandpur Hospital for treatment but on the way Julfu Master died, when they came back with the dead body. It appears that all connecting links of the case were proved and established by above public and official witnesses. It appears that CS witness Nos. 7, 11-13 and 19 were not examined at the trial. We do not find any reason for any adverse presumption due to non- examination of above CS witnesses.
